configureTitle: Header title of the fullscreen suggestion-source configure screens (global and Suggested edits).
dismissedModules: Heading above the list of Home modules the user dismissed, on the configure suggestions screen.
restore: Button next to a dismissed module that brings it back to Home.
done: Full-width button that closes a configure screen.
useDefaultSettings: Toggle on the Suggested edits configure screen: when on, the module follows the global Personalization settings instead of its own.
homeLayoutTitle: Title of the dialog where the user chooses and reorders the modules shown on Home.
homeLayoutSubtitle: Subtitle of the Home layout dialog.
loadingArticle: Accessible label (aria-label) of the progress bar shown while an article loads.
articleLoadError: Error shown when an article fails to load. $1 = technical error message (not translated).
